tei:div.tei:p: 253) ༄༅/ dkon mchog gi drung du mchod pa 'bul ba la nye bar 'kho ba bzhugs so/ 254) na mo/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bden pa'i stobs mnga' ba rnams kyi thugs rje nus mthu dang*/ bdag gi dad mos lhag bsam dag pa'i mthu stobs dang*/ chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// mchod pa'i yo byad ji ltar bshams shing phul ba 'di dag mtshon byed du byas te/ phyogs bcu rab 'byams kyi sangs rgyas byang sems zhing khams nam mkha'i mthas gtugs su khyab pa'i skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum gyi spyan sngar/ mchod yon me tog bdug spos 255) mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa'ilalasprin phung rgya che zhing rgyun mi chad pa/ kun tu bzang po'i ting 'dzin smon lam las byung ba'i mchod sprin dang mnyam pa 'byung bar gyur cig na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo bha ga wa te/ badz+ra sā ra pra ma dha ne/ ta thā ga ta ya ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ om̐ badz+re badz+re/ ma hā badz+re/ ma hā te dza badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta badz+re*/ ma hā bo dhi man+t+ro pa saṃ pra ma ṇa badz+re/ sarba karma a wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na badz+re swā hā/ 256) na ma sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra/ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke/ ghan+de/ nai wi d+ya/ shap+ta pra tī ts+tsha āḥhūm̐/ skyabs gnas bla ma dkon mchog yi dam lha/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong bka' srung thams cad kyi// spyan sngar mchod pa'i sprin phung 'di phul bas// dgyes par bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ stong gsum 'jig rten bye ba phrag brgya yi// snod bcud mchod pa'i ngo bo ji snyed dang*/ bdag lus longs spyod gtan gyi bdun mar bcas// mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal nyid du 'bul lags na// bdag sogs nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can kun// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang*// las nyon sdig sgrib ma lus byang gyur nas// thar lam byang chub dam pa thob par shog

/'di ltar mchod pa phul ba'i dge 'bras kyis// rgyal khams bde zhing nad mug 'khrug rtsod med// sangs rgyas bstan dar bstan pa 'dzin 257) kun mthun// thams cad dam pa'i chos la spyod gyur cig dkon mchog bden pa'i mthu stobs rmad byung dang*// bdag gi dad pas mchod cing gsol btab pa'i// dge bas ci bsam 'grub cing bar chad zhi// mchog thun dngos grub tshe 'dir thob par shog

de yang dkon mchog gi drung du mchod pa 'bul ba'i mchod rdzas byin rlabs kyi rim pa cho ga'i gzhung sogs la ni tha dad la zhib rgyas 'byung mod kyang*/ cho ga sogs dang ma 'brel bar gtsug lag khang dang mchod bsham kyi drung sogs su mchod pa 'bul tshe byin rlabs med ni med rung la/ bdag bskyed sogs med phyir byin gyis rlobs pa'i nus pa yang mi 'byung ba dang*/ de lta bu la 'di ni dkon mchog gi bden pa'i stobs kyi sgo nas byin rlabs yin pas na/ gtsug lag gi dkor gnyer la sogs la lhag par gal che bar yod pa dang*/ gong gi mchod pa sprin gyi gzungs de lan gcig brjod pas kyang mchod pa thams cad brgya stong du 'gyur bar gsungs te/ dper na mar me gcig phul nas lhag bsam dag pas 258) gzungs 'di brjod na mar me brgya stong mang por phul bar 'gyur zhing*/ mchod pa gzhan thams cad la yang des mtshon pas shes par bya'o/ mchod pa phul ba la med rung zhing nye bar 'kho ba 'di ni/ mtha' 'khob kla klo'i dpon po pad+ma tshe dbang gi bskul ngor/ sna tshogs rang grol gyi rgod phug brag tu bkod pa dge'o/
